remarks: Exceptional new construction by Compo Luxury Homes on 2.1 private acres just minutes to downtown Westport, Compo Beach and the train. Offering approximately 9,200 square feet on four finished levels with 6 bedrooms, 6 full and 3 half baths. Designed for modern living with European tilt-and-turn windows and lift-and-slide doors, custom millwork, white oak floors and Lutron lighting. Chef's kitchen with double quartzite waterfall islands, custom rift white oak cabinetry, Sub-Zero refrigeration, Miele appliances, Gaggenau microwave and walk-in pantry. Premium features include a DaVinci slate roof, dramatic floating staircase, whole-house Generac generator and thoughtfully integrated smart home technology. Primary suite with cathedral ceiling, white oak beams, fireplace, private deck, dual walk-in closets and spa bath with heated floors, soaking tub and curbless shower. Four additional en-suite bedrooms, 2 home offices and finished third floor. Walk-out lower level with family room, wet bar, gym, guest suite and optional theater or golf simulator. Heated gunite pool, year-round spa, covered porch with fireplace and outdoor kitchen, room for tennis or pickleball court. Three-car garage, 7-zone HVAC, security camera system and exceptional craftsmanship complete this remarkable offering.
